summary: Allow human owner manual merge and override on autonomy failure

delivery.outcome: Allow authenticated human repository owners to perform manual steering and direct manual merges with autonomy-degraded override while keeping interactive AI agents strictly prohibited from self-approval or merge, and record preservation of manual owner merges.
nonGoals: Allowing interactive or coding AI agents to self-approve, run personal gh pr merge, or impersonate the human owner.

architecture.decision: Extend merge-rules.env, merge-events.env, merge_contracts.py, merge_dsl_events.py, and merge_adversarial.py so executor=owner is admissible for merge with green preconditions or explicit autonomy-degraded + owner-manual-override evidence, add AUTONOMY_DEGRADED_MANUAL_OVERRIDE and OWNER_MANUAL_MERGE_OBSERVED events, and document the boundary in AUTONOMOUS_MERGE.md, MERGE_EVENTS.md, MRG-MERGE-001.md, and docs/decisions/human-manual-override-on-autonomy-failure.md.

validation.evidence: Conformance, CQRS conformance, governance check, and wellman check exit 0 with 0 errors.
